name: SonarQube Cloud
description: SonarQube Cloud lets agents read issues, security hotspots, quality gate status, and metrics for projects in the organizations of the signed-in user. This address is for the EU region of SonarQube Cloud.

prompts.text: Did the quality gate pass on the main branch of my project?
List the critical issues in my project that are still open.
Explain the newest security hotspot in my project and suggest a fix.

apps.name: SonarQube Cloud
apps.description: Issues, security hotspots, and quality gates, over SonarQube Cloud's MCP server with browser sign-in.
